note: Two modes. Baseline runs all year while not travelling. Window phases tighten the age limit for places in a declared travel window, their parents (laws stack) and any permit zones inside them.

phases.task: record what was learned; fold shareable findings into public vetting

lead_time_rule: The approach phase starts at whichever is earlier: 90 days out, or the longest permit lead time in the zone scan plus the buffer.
